content: Ña Pablo gi Chigambe sema'su. Jesucristone afa'su gi. Jesúsja ñama ttu'sepa moen Chiga in'jan'cho aindeccuma fuitesi cuintsu Tise've ti'tsse in'jan'faye. Tsendeccunga tsu ñama moen Chiga tansintsse su'choma atesiansi cuintsu ñotsse atesupa canse'faye.
Tsa'caen in'jamba atesupa tsu tisupa tsangae canse'faya'chone'qque in'jamba ronda'je'faya. Nane toya andeve agattoembi'te tsu Chigaja ingine tsangae canseya'chove in'jan. Tiseja afopoen'masiapa
ja'ño Tise in'jan'cho a'ta napisi inginga tansintsse a'tatssia've conda. Nane Chiga ingima ccushaen'su ñama ttu'sepa mandasi gi va tsangae canseya'chone condase'choma candusian'jen.

Tito, queja ña condasesi Chiga Aya'fama pañamba qui fae'ngae ñai'ccu in'jamba ñoa'me ña dutssi'yea'can. Quenga gi tevavaen'jen. In'jan gi cuintsu Chiga ingi Quitsa, Cristo Jesús ingima Ccushaen'su'qque quema mende'yepa ñotsse tsonsi opatsse canseye.

Ñajan quema Creta anttepo'choni cati cuintsu ingi toya nanimbi'choa sema'bama semamba ñoñañe. Toya'caen poi canqque'su Cristove in'jamba bo'je'cho nasundeccuma ttu'seye gi manda. Ña manda'choma ñotsse injan'jenjan:

Majan na'suve da'ta tsu egae tsincon'chove mecho canseya'cho cca'indeccu tisema afase'fasa'ne. Fae'ccoeyi tsu pushepa can'jeña'cho. Toya'caen tise dushundeccu'qque Cristove in'jamba ñotsse canse'faya'cho. Tsa'caen tsu canse'faya'cho cca'indeccu “Tsambe du'shuja pañambipa in'jangae canse” qquen afasesa'ne.

Nane Cristove in'jamba bo'je'cho na'suja Chigambe sema'su tsu. Tsa'camba tsu egae tsincon'chove mecho canseya'cho. Tisu in'jan'chove panshaen in'jambipa junde iyicca'yembe'yi tsu canseya'cho. Toya'caen ccusimbe'yi ni tssetsseccombe'yi tsu canseya'cho. Toya'caen aqquiatsse ganañe in'jambe'yi tsu canseya'cho.

Tsa'ma cca'indeccuma ñotsse in'jamba tsu tisu tsa'onga ansundiaña'cho. Osha'chone ñotsse in'jamba tsu injiengepa canseya'cho. Ño'ame dapa tsu Chiga in'janqquia'caen canseya'cho. Tisu injama'choma ñotsse in'jamba ñotsse canseya'cho.

Toya'caen tseyi Chiga tansintsse su'choma tayo pañaqquia'caeñi tsu ñotsse in'jaña'cho. Tsa'caen tansintsse su'choma in'jamba tsu cca'indeccuma ñotsse atesiaña'cho. Tsa'caen tansintsse atesiamba tsu ccaningae in'jan'chondeccuma'qque tansintsse canjaemba tansiaña'cho cuintsu tsendeccu'qque ñotsse in'jan'faye.
Nane tsain'bitssi a'i tsu ñotsse atesian'choma pañañe in'jambipa injanga atesiamba cca'indeccuma afopoen'fa. Ttonoma chhiyitevaemba ccushaye in'jan'chondeccu tsu ti'tsse tsa'caen injanga atesian'fa.
Tise'pa atesian'jen'choma gi ziyaen'faya'cho. Ñoa'me tise'pa atesian'jen'choi'ccu tsu tsa'onga ca'nimba poiyi'cco tseni'su a'ima qqueña'fa. Injanga ganañe in'jamba tsu tsa'caen egae atesian'fa.
Nane fa'e tise'pa'su Creta a'inga afa'su tsu su: “Cretasundeccuja tsave afopoensundeccu tsu. Nane putsa'supa noe'supa panshaen tsu fiestaen'fa.”
Tise su'choja ñoa'me su'cho tsu. Tsa'cansi Cretasundeccuma quia'me iyu'uja cuintsu Cristove tansintsse in'jan'faye.

Tise'pama iyu'uja israendeccu injanga condase'choma paña'fasa'ne. Toya'caen majan atesiansundeccuja ñotsse tansintsse Chiga su'choma catipa a'ima ccaningae manda'fa. Cretasundeccuma iyu'uja cuintsu tsendeccuma pañambecan'faye.

Majan a'i injama'choni ñotsse in'jansi tsu tisenijan osha'cho ñotsseyi jincho tsa'ma majan a'i Cristove in'jambi'nijan tise'pa injama'cho'qque ñotssimbi tsu. Tsendeccunijan jongoesuyi'qque ñotssiaja jimbi. Nane tise'pa injama'cho, tise'pa in'jan'cho'qque ñoa'me dañonge'cho tsu.
Aya'fai'ccuja Chigave in'jan qquen tsu su'fa. Tsa'ma tise'pa tson'choi'ccu Chigama a'tien'fa. Tsa'cansi Chigaja tise'pama chi'ga. Nane tise'paja Chigama pañambipa ñotsse tsoñe osha'fambi.
